verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Terminal supports both digital (email/SMS via receipt_email) and printed receipts, that prebuilt email receipts include all card-network-required fields, and that merchants must offer physical or email receipt options; custom receipts can also be built from API data while still including required information. This directly matches the story's requirement for compliant digital/printed receipts. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of receipt compliance beyond first-party docs, and no explicit SMS receipt mechanism (only email is documented).
